description: A single slide with empty or whitespace-only text crashes the ENTIRE deck. compose_slides.py:51 builds lines = [l for l in s['text'].split('\n') if l.strip()]; if that yields [], line 56 'fsize = 104 if max(len(l) for l in lines) <= 6 else 86' calls max() on an empty sequence → ValueError → the whole compose_slides.py process aborts → producer.sh:36 catches it as 'compose failed' and NOTHING is queued. One bad slide kills the whole daily run. No per-slide guard, no skip, no test for empty/missing text.

evidence.snippet: lines = [l for l in s["text"].split("\n") if l.strip()] ... fsize = 104 if max(len(l) for l in lines) <= 6 else 86
